LanguageData.CC_PplR8_ClothGone: The cloth is no longer in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_PplR8_TowerRaised: {PAWN} has raised the Signal Line's flag tower. The colony's letters go down the line by flag and lamp now, and the watchers will pass a warning along when raiders are on the road.
LanguageData.CC_PplR8_Impact_Tower: The lineman raises a flag tower {0}. While it works, the colony's letters reach their readers in half the days, passed from tower to tower by flag and lamp, and the line warns of a raid a little before it comes. A thunderstorm wears it; under half its strength it stops working until mended.
LanguageData.CC_PplR8_TowerWearing: swaying in the wind and losing its ropes
